messages:
Neha (Product): Customer A asked to onboard their regulated workload next quarter. We need to align on acceptance criteria for platform slices and routing policies. Quick sync: what absolutely must ship for them to go-live?
Liam (Eng-Arch): At minimum: tenant isolation lanes (resource slices), routing policy templates (affinity + fallback), and region-aware routing. Also model-variant fallback config.
Jordan (SRE): + Observability: per-tenant latency/cost dashboards, trace-level sampling for canary, eviction/playbook docs. Rollback hooks and automatic fallback to lower-tier model.
Vivian (Solutions): Customer asks: VPC peering, KMS integration, audit logs retention 1yr, and contract SLA 99.9p. They also want capacity reservations during peak windows.
Mike (Eng Lead): Suggest MLP: 1) routing templates + simple tenant slice (soft isolation), 2) per-tenant metrics + basic audit logs, 3) fallback policy. Keep VPC/KMS as gated enterprise add-on (Q4).
Neha (Product): Proposed launch acceptance checklist: - Routing templates in console + API - Slice creation API with quota limits - Per-tenant SLA metrics (P95 latency, error rate) - Canary rollout with automatic fallback - Audit log pipeline (ingest->s3) - Docs + runbook for oncall
Jordan (SRE): Need to add failure injection test and capacity cutover playbook to checklist. Also SLO burn rate alerting thresholds.
Liam (Eng-Arch): For routing templates, we need schema + validation. I'll post a short RFC with policy DSL example tonight. Example snippet: ```policy { affinity: region("us-east"); fallback: variant("gptq-medium"); max_latency_ms: 250 }```
Vivian (Solutions): From sales: If we don't have VPC/KMS at launch, they might still sign if we provide capacity reservation + audit guarantees. Let's make reservation flow easy.
Neha (Product): Prioritization vote: A) ship MLP as Mike suggested; B) accelerate KMS/VPC; C) deeper isolation lanes. Please react with :one:/:two:/:three:.
Sam (Customer A): We're fine with the MLP as long as reservation + audit logs exist. We'll do a pilot in us-east.
rollout-bot: Note: added 'platform-slice' epic to roadmap with target Q3-beta.
Neha (Product): Next steps: Liam to RFC routing DSL (EOD), Jordan to draft SRE checklist (tomorrow), Mike to propose MLP scope PR (Mon). I'll update roadmap and share with Sam. Thanks all :raised_hands:
